# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation this pull request addresses.

## Solution

Describe the chosen approach and any alternatives you rejected.

## Verification

- [ ] `task check` passes
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests
- [ ] Manual TUI check completed when the UI changed
- [ ] Linux behavior checked
- [ ] macOS behavior checked
- [ ] Windows behavior checked

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated `README.md`
- [ ] Updated the relevant file in `docs/`
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No documentation change required

## Scope and security

- [ ] The change stays within the local-only scope
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, real prompt text, or private paths are included
- [ ] Security issues are reported through `SECURITY.md`, not in this pull request
